base_setup_commands: apt-get install -y git curl pkg-config libasound2-dev libudev-dev libwayland-dev libxkbcommon-dev ca-certificates build-essential libssl-dev
activation_command: export RUSTUP_HOME=/opt/rustup && export CARGO_HOME=/opt/cargo && export PATH="$CARGO_HOME/bin:$PATH"

runtime_profile.test_only_install_strategy: cargo test will automatically fetch and build dependencies from crates.io
runtime_profile.notes: Bevy 0.13.0 requires Rust 1.76.0+. Using stable toolchain for compatibility with latest dependencies. System dependencies for Linux: libasound2-dev (ALSA), libudev-dev, libwayland-dev, libxkbcommon-dev.

notes: Base image debian:bookworm provides git and curl by default but they are explicitly included in system_packages for clarity. Rust is installed via rustup with stable toolchain. The project requires Rust 1.76.0+ and Bevy 0.13.0 is compatible with stable Rust. System dependencies are required for Linux audio (ALSA), input (udev), and display (Wayland, xkbcommon) support.
